title: Daily Lab
tagline: A software studio that ships products people actually want.
summary: Daily Lab is a hybrid services-and-SaaS studio building a suite of developer and business tools — Daily Reach, Daily Pay, Daily Invoice, and Daily Host.
description: Daily Lab operates as a hybrid business: client services fund the studio while a growing suite of SaaS products builds long-term recurring revenue. The brand system is deliberately monochrome and restrained, letting the products speak for themselves.
As founder and lead engineer, I set the technical direction across every product, designed the shared design language, and built the foundational architecture each tool extends from.
highlights: Shipped four distinct products under one ecosystem
Built a shared component library used across all products
Established a monochrome brand system and 52-week content calendar

title: HunterPro Academy
tagline: A full-stack e-learning SaaS with an AI tutor at its core.
summary: A certification-prep platform combining a RAG-based AI chatbot, AI quiz generation, voice chat, and multi-provider subscription billing.
description: HunterPro Academy is a comprehensive e-learning platform built for certification preparation. At its heart is a retrieval-augmented AI tutor with strict knowledge-scoping and multi-provider failover, so answers stay accurate and the service stays online.
I worked across the entire stack — from the RAG backend and embedding pipeline to the React frontend, exam-taking flow, and admin analytics dashboards.
highlights: RAG AI chatbot with OpenAI → Claude → DeepSeek failover
Voice chat via MediaRecorder, Whisper STT, and TTS
Subscription billing across Stripe, Flutterwave, Paystack & Monnify

title: Daily Pay
tagline: A payment aggregation platform with a minimalist interface.
summary: A clean black-and-white payment aggregation dashboard — app management, transaction analytics, and a multi-step onboarding flow.
description: Daily Pay aggregates multiple payment providers behind a single API. I built the full React frontend with a minimalist black-and-white design system and a consistent split-screen layout pattern.
The interface covers everything from a three-step registration flow to a transaction explorer with drawers, filters, and analytics.
highlights: Full frontend: auth, dashboard, app CRUD, transactions
Transaction explorer with drawer, filters & analytics

title: Daily Reach
tagline: An email & SMS marketing platform, redesigned to minimalism.
summary: A systematic redesign of ~20 components from neo-brutalist to a refined, minimalist aesthetic inspired by Linear and Stripe.
description: Daily Reach is an email and SMS marketing platform. I led a full visual redesign — converting roughly twenty React components from a neo-brutalist look to a calm, minimalist aesthetic.
The work spanned auth pages, the dashboard, campaign and customer management, a TipTap-powered template editor, and a forms builder.
highlights: Redesigned ~20 components to a minimalist system

title: AHTI Website
tagline: A multi-page institutional site with a strict design system.
summary: The Arewa Health Trust Initiative website — built from scratch with a navy, green and white design system.
description: AHTI is a multi-page React and TypeScript site built on Vite. It follows a strict design system — navy, green, and white, with no gradients and no emojis.
I built every component from the homepage through a full gallery page with filtering, search, and pagination.
highlights: Built from scratch: header through full gallery page
Strict navy / green / white design system

title: AWS Cloud Club BUK
tagline: A multi-page community site with live event integration.
summary: The official site for the AWS Cloud Club at Bayero University Kano — landing, events, admin and team pages.
description: A multi-page static site for the AWS Cloud Club at Bayero University Kano, built with a dark navy and gold design system.
It features live API integration for events, a registration modal with deep linking, an admin event-creation page, and a JSON-driven team page.
highlights: Live event API integration with registration modal
